kurz: Poultry has two challenges: lean breast meat that dries out quickly, and skin that should turn crisp.
bild_im_kopf: Two guests with different wishes at the same table: the breast wants it gentle, the leg wants it longer, the skin wants it dry and hot.
was_passiert: Breast meat is lean and dries out quickly. Even so, poultry must be cooked through: at least 70 °C at the core for two minutes is recommended, because of [[salmonellen|salmonella]] and campylobacter. Legs have more connective tissue and can take more heat. The skin only turns crisp once its water has evaporated and the fat has rendered.
warum_wichtig: Dry salting, air-drying uncovered and a thermometer solve almost all poultry problems.
faustregeln: Thermometer in the thickest part of the breast: at least 70 °C, then straight off the heat. Dry salting or a brine keeps the meat juicy.
Start duck skin in a cold pan.
